text: Should the attribute be applied to all generated types, including the generated resolver, or only to formatters?
why_it_matters: If all types, the resolver templates need the attribute and the current change is incomplete. If formatters only, the change meets the intent and the README wording is fine.

text: Should there be an opt-out setting for the attribute?
why_it_matters: The requirement allows either. Unconditional means the change is complete. An opt-out means a missing setting is a gap.

text: Should ExcludeFromCodeCoverage also be applied to the generated resolver class and its nested helper/cache classes, or only to the generated formatter types?
options: All generated types including the resolver and its helpers
why_it_matters: If all generated types are in scope, the untouched resolver template is a requirement gap (medium/high). If only formatters are in scope, the resolver finding is withdrawn.
